question: Select the most appropriate option to fill in blank number 2.
solution:
The correct answer is '**philosophical**'.

 

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__** 

__
 
• The sentence says — “Judged solely in terms of his (2) ______ influence, only Plato is his peer.”
 
• The context compares Aristotle and Plato — both were major figures in the field of philosophy.
 
• "**Philosophical**" influence fits logically because it highlights Aristotle’s impact on philosophy over centuries.
 
• Other options like "**modernity**", "**society**", and "**history**" do not describe the nature of influence relevant to the context.

Therefore, the correct answer is '**Option 1**'.

 

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

 
• **Modernity**: Refers to the modern era or mindset — unrelated to Aristotle’s influence.
 
• **Society**: Refers to people or social structures — not about intellectual influence.
 
• **History**: Refers to past events — doesn’t specify the type of influence.
